def transform(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # find pattern: maximal contiguous non-bg line segment with length>1
    pat=None
    # horizontal
    for i in range(h):
        j=0
        while j<w:
            if g[i][j]!=bg:
                k=j
                while k<w and g[i][k]!=bg: k+=1
                if k-j>1: pat=[(0,d,g[i][d]) for d in range(j,k)]
                j=k
            else: j+=1
    if pat is None:
        for j in range(w):
            i=0
            while i<h:
                if g[i][j]!=bg:
                    k=i
                    while k<h and g[i][k]!=bg: k+=1
                    if k-i>1: pat=[(d,1,g[d][j]) for d in range(i,k)]
                    i=k
                else: i+=1
    # anchor = length of first run
    a=1
    while a<len(pat) and pat[a][2]==pat[0][2]: a+=1
    dr,dc=pat[a][0]-pat[0][0], pat[a][1]-pat[0][1]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]!=bg and not any((i,j)==(pi,pj) for pi,pj,_ in pat):
                # marker
                base=(i-dr, j-dc)
                for r,c,v in pat:
                    rr,cc=base[0]+r, base[1]+c
                    if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w: out[rr][cc]=v
    return out
